title: Combining Distributed and Kernel Tracing for Performance Analysis of Cloud Applications

summary.core_contribution: This paper combines distributed tracing with kernel tracing to analyze cloud-application performance across software layers.
summary.problem: Distributed traces show request-level structure but may omit operating-system evidence needed to explain resource and scheduling effects.
summary.method: The approach correlates distributed-application trace information with kernel-level tracing for cross-layer performance analysis.
summary.findings: The paper contributes a combined tracing perspective for cloud applications; tracer configuration, correlation method, and measurements require full-text review.
summary.limitations: The current catalog captures bibliographic evidence but not the full text; quantitative results, implementation details, and paper-specific validity threats require source review.
summary.future_work: Evaluate correlation accuracy, overhead, cloud heterogeneity, and compatibility with modern OpenTelemetry pipelines.
